fullContentHtml:
MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Online Form 2025 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the post of Group 4 Stenographer. This recruitment has been issued for 861 posts. Online applying process for MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Recruitment 2025 will start from 04 February 2025 & the candidates can apply till18 February 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 February 2025
  • Last Date : 18 February 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 18 February 2025
  • Exam Date : 30 March 2025
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Category : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 250/-
  • EWS / PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

  • Apply OnlineApply Online

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Online Form 2025?

MPESB Group 4 Stenographer Online Form 2025 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 18 February 2025.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://esb.mp.gov.in/e_default.html

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
